feeds.title: Tech in Asia » Indonesia
feeds.description: Indonesia's section of Tech in Asia covers the latest news, headlines, articles, and more on Technology. Tech in Asia is the largest English-language technology media company that focuses on Asia. From the latest news to the hottest trends and the boldest startups to the strongest titans, we cover everything tech in the region. Our goal is to build and serve Asia's tech and startup community.

feeds.title: TipsPintar.com
feeds.description: 'TipsPintar.com' was founded on April 19, 2017, by a small group of teenagers who are very enthusiastic about developments in the world of technology. Our goal is to educate Indonesian children with current technological developments, by providing educational articles wrapped in easy-to-understand discussions.

feeds.title: TechCrunch » Indonesia
feeds.description: The following section of TechCrunch is dedicated to Indonesia, covering tech news, headlines, and insight. TechCrunch, founded on June 11, 2005, is a blog dedicated to obsessively profiling and reviewing new Internet products and companies.

feeds.title: Jagat Review
feeds.description: Jagat Review is a group of passionate young testers and seasoned experience reviewers/editors, dedicated to delivering cutting edge tech reviews on the web.

feeds.title: AsiaQuest Indonesia
feeds.description: AsiaQuest Indonesia is determined to actively contribute to the growth and advancement of the IT and digital world in Indonesia through various web and digital transformation solutions. We believe that a solid and reliable team is the main power in developing digital services. AsiaQuest Indonesia has a collection of the latest IT news, IT information in Indonesia, and technology news.
